name: Green bean (food medium)
description: Food-derived medium: metabolizable components of Green bean (Phaseolus vulgaris) [Pulses] from FooDB, plus a standard M9 mineral base. Organic components use presence-based uptake bounds; FooDB content retained. Measured compounds with no BiGG exchange are listed under uncovered.

provenance.citation: FooDB v2020-04-07 (Wishart DS et al., foodb.ca). Content sources: DTU, MANUAL, PHENOL EXPLORER, USDA, Wikipedia.
provenance.notes: Organic components mapped from FooDB compounds to BiGG via InChIKey/name. Mineral base added. Bounds presence-based; foodb_content retained. Unmapped measured compounds kept in uncovered (v2 completeness fix). IMPORTANT: composition values are taken from the archived FooDB 2020-04-07 CSV data release; FooDB's live food page no longer displays this bulk composition, so it will appear empty. Verify individual compounds via the per-component cross-reference links. Underlying content was aggregated by FooDB from USDA / DTU / Phenol Explorer.
provenance.verification: expert-curated (multi-source food composition; growth-relevant profile completed, FooDB noise removed)
provenance.curation_notes: Dominant carbon/energy sources: free glucose (1.51) + fructose (1.39) g/100g, backed by low starch (0.88) and modest sucrose. Organic-acid pool is malate-dominant (was entirely missing from the FooDB record); malic and citric fresh-weight amounts could not be extracted from open (paywalled) sources so are reported present-but-unquantified with a titratable-acidity anchor (~0.16 g/100g as citric-eq). Amino-acid profile from USDA SR (cooked profile used as representative; raw values near-identical
curation_added: malic acid (DOMINANT organic acid, was absent)
total titratable acidity anchor (0.16 g/100g as citric-eq)
individual sugars quantified: glucose 1.51, fructose 1.39, sucrose 0.36 g/100g
quantified vitamins (C, B1-B9, E, K1) and minerals (K, P, Ca, Mg, Na, Fe, Zn, Mn, Cu, Se)

curation_removed.name: Creatine cytosol
curation_removed.reason: Animal metabolite (muscle phosphagen); not synthesized by plants. FooDB predicted/implausible in a plant pod.

curation_removed.name: Taurine C2H7NO3S
curation_removed.reason: Sulfonic amino acid essentially absent from higher plants; animal-associated. FooDB predicted noise.

curation_removed.name: L-Methionine Sulfoxide
curation_removed.reason: Oxidation artifact of methionine, not a defining nutrient; fold into L-methionine.

curation_removed.name: Racemethionine
curation_removed.reason: DL-methionine is a synthetic racemate; the natural pod contains only L-methionine (already listed). Artifactual.

curation_removed.name: Iron (Fe3+) / Fe2+ mitochondria
curation_removed.reason: Redundant BiGG compartment/oxidation-state duplicates of iron; consolidated into a single 'iron' (total Fe = 1.03 mg/100g).

curation_removed.name: CO2 CO2 / O2 O2 / H+ / H2O H2O (as nutrients)
curation_removed.reason: Gases/solvent/proton are medium/atmosphere terms, not food-derived growth nutrients (water retained explicitly as solvent 90.3 g).

coverage_source.definition: pct_covered_all = components / (components + unresolved ingredients) — the legacy metric, which counts pipeline-derived components as covered. pct_covered_source = source-stated components / (those + unresolved ingredients + ingredients replaced by derived components). Component classes come from tools/component_evidence_classes.tsv. A null value means the denominator was zero; it does not mean 100.
